name: waas-mcp
description: Search, inspect, and apply to YC Work at a Startup jobs from your AI assistant.
long_description:
MCP server for [Work at a Startup](https://www.workatastartup.com) — YC's job board.

**Search** with structured filters (role, remote, visa, keywords). **Inspect** each application for custom questions, resume URLs, and external apply links. **Submit** with dry-run safety by default.

**Before applying**, sign in once from a terminal in the extension folder:

```bash
npm run login
```

Session is saved to `~/.waas-mcp/storage-state.json`.

tools.name: waas_auth_status
tools.description: Check Work at a Startup login session.

tools.description: Search jobs with structured filters (role, remote, visa, keywords).

tools.description: Fetch company profile and open roles.

tools.name: waas_inspect_application
tools.description: Inspect application requirements: fields, type, external links.

tools.name: waas_list_applied
tools.description: List jobs submitted via this MCP (local tracker).
